description: CMBS originators ranked by loan volume over the last 12 months, from the originator named on each loan in the trusts' SEC filings. Filter by property type, state and loan amount (keeps lenders whose securitized loan sizes span it). Returns volume, loan count, size range, median rate, leverage and a page per lender.

limit.description: How many lenders to return, 1 to 30. Default 10.

property_type.description: Property type: multifamily, retail, office, hotel, self-storage, industrial, mixed-use, mobile-home-park, co-op, healthcare. Omit for all types.

state.description: US state as a two-letter code (TX) or a name (Texas). Omit for all states.

name: find_cmbs_lenders
title: Find CMBS lenders
